text:
Your CRM is full of leads. Most of them will never buy.

The hard part isn't finding accounts — it's knowing which ones deserve your team's time this week.

So I built CRM Scoring. Upload your CRM export and every account is ranked Hot / Warm / Cold against your ideal customer profile, with a short reason for each.

Free to start: https://www.crmscoring.com

3 signs a lead is worth a call this week:

1. They match your best customers on industry and size
2. They're hiring — new roles mean new budget
3. They already use tools that work with yours

CRM Scoring checks all three for every account in your CRM export and tells you which to call first.

https://www.crmscoring.com

This is what you see a minute after uploading your CRM export.

Every account scored and bucketed, the Hot / Warm / Cold mix at a glance, and exactly where your list drops off.

No setup, no integration project. Try it on your own data, free: https://www.crmscoring.com

Lead scoring shouldn't be a black box.

CRM Scoring gives every account a rule-based score you can check — industry, company size, revenue, tech stack, location, each weighted and shown.

Then an AI note explains what the rules can't see: new funding, active hiring, competitor tools.

https://www.crmscoring.com

What CRM Scoring deliberately does NOT do:

• Write or send outreach for you
• Change your CRM unless you click
• Score individual people

It ranks accounts and shows your team where to look. The decisions stay with your team.

https://www.crmscoring.com

Score your leads. Keep your data.

CRM Scoring is self-hosted: it runs on your own infrastructure, so your CRM export doesn't sit on someone else's servers.
